historical_references.reference: Munal ibn Shikrak was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and one of the earliest converts to Islam. He was a member of the Ansar (helpers) of Medina, and played a key role in the Battle of Uhud (625 AD).

historical_references.reference: Munal al-Daradami was a renowned scholar and theologian in the early Islamic period, known for his expertise in hadith and fiqh. He was born in Darad, Iraq, and lived during the late Umayyad and early Abbasid periods (around 700-770 AD).
